name: Timestamps
description: Shows created/updated timestamps at the top or bottom of notes.
author: Ole Eskild Steensen

settings.name: Timestamp position
settings.description: Where timestamps are shown: in the header at the top, after the content at the bottom, or both.

settings.name: Show on home page
settings.description: Also show timestamps on the home page.

settings.name: Timestamp format
settings.description: Luxon format string for values with a time component. Tokens are case-sensitive: use yyyy for the year, not YYYY.

settings.name: Date format
settings.description: Luxon format string for date-only values. Tokens are case-sensitive: use yyyy for the year, not YYYY.
